what_this_is: (z,x,y) to PMTiles v3 Hilbert tile id. Every tile_id is the return value of pmtiles.ZxyToID from the pinned go-pmtiles source. Nothing here was computed by hand or from a reading of the spec.

how_each_number_was_obtained.roundtrip_z/x/y: pmtiles.IDToZxy(tile_id), reported so each pair carries its own check
how_each_number_was_obtained.roundtrip_ok: roundtrip_z/x/y == z/x/y, computed by the dump program, not by go-pmtiles
how_each_number_was_obtained.parent_id: pmtiles.ParentID(tile_id); it is only meaningful for z >= 1, and the value stored against the z=0 tile is a zero placeholder, not a measurement
how_each_number_was_obtained.last_tile_id: pmtiles.ZxyToID(z+1, 0, 0) - 1, and the (x,y) recorded against it comes back from pmtiles.IDToZxy of that id, so the coordinate is go-pmtiles' answer and not mine
how_each_number_was_obtained.tile_count: last_tile_id - first_tile_id + 1, arithmetic done by the dump program

sections.first_and_last_of_level: the first and last tile of z=0..8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20 and 31
sections.orientation_boundaries: the four tiles straddling the grid centre at several zooms, which is where the Hilbert sub-curve changes orientation, plus the three non-origin corners of z=2, 4, 8 and 14
sections.off_grid: coordinates that are not round numbers, including real-world z14 tiles
sections.hilbert_order_z2: all 16 tiles of z=2 in tile-id order
sections.hilbert_order_z3: all 64 tiles of z=3 in tile-id order
sections.level_bases: first id, last id and tile count per zoom level
sections.out_of_range_observations: NOT vectors to match. These record what go-pmtiles does when handed an x, y or z outside the valid domain, so our reader can refuse rather than reproduce it. See FINDINGS.md.
sections.convention_discriminators: the rows that tell the candidate Hilbert conventions apart. The structural coordinates in the other sections agree under several different mappings, plain Z-order with no rotation among them, so they cannot settle which convention PMTiles uses. These are mid-to-high zoom, off every quadrant boundary, with x and y of differing parity, and they include swapped pairs so a symmetric mapping cannot survive them.

convention_discriminator_note.meaning: go-pmtiles returns 19078479 for this row, which is what the spec lane derived independently from the specification text and is none of the three rejected candidates. The measurement and the derivation agree.
